titulo: Can you thaw meat on the counter?
fuentes: USDA FSIS: The Big Thaw — Safe Defrosting Methods
USDA FSIS: Danger Zone (40 °F–140 °F) and the two-hour rule

frases.texto: You thaw your meat on the counter all morning.

frases.estilo: Dry and punchy, with a half smile.

frases.texto: The outside warms up while the middle can still be frozen.
That outer layer can end up between forty and one hundred forty degrees, where bacteria multiply fast.
The USDA says it plain: never thaw meat on the counter.
Three safe ways. The fridge: safest, but plan ahead.
Cold water, in a leakproof bag, changing the water every thirty minutes.
Or the microwave, then cook it right away.
Heads up: perishable food shouldn't sit out more than two hours, or one hour at ninety degrees or hotter.
So tonight, move the meat from the freezer to the fridge. Done.
Send this to the friend who leaves the chicken out on the counter all day.
